Meetings

The Community Board meets on the 2nd Monday of each month; however, if a holiday falls on that day, the meeting is rescheduled to the 4th Monday of the month. "Date and time subject to change at the discretion of the Chairman"

 

Our Regular & Public Hearing meeting will be November 16, 2026 at 7:00 p.m.

Meeting is held at:

St. Luke-Msgr. Tosi Pastoral Center

16-34 Clintonville Street

Whitestone, NY 11357

Parking is available across the street 

 

There are no scheduled committee meeting at this time.


Please feel free to contact us Monday thru Friday 9:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. with any questions.
